purpose: Select a reading shortlist of eight main and two promising/unusual essays from22 frozen current versions. This is substantive selection, not manuscript revision.

judge_allocation.rule: Shuffle blinded candidate and profile lists with a fixed local RNG; allocate two distinct profiles per manuscript, each of23 profiles used once or twice. Frozen before review. Equal number and depth of reviews, no topic or doctrinal agreement bonus.
judge_allocation.scope_limit: Sample of two named profiles per essay, not full-panel prediction or controlled estimate of individual judge effects.

freshness: One new CLI session per review, inline complete manuscript plus neutral rubric and its assigned profile/evidence only; no memories, AGENTS, tools, other essays, old ratings or histories. Pair sessions receive only their two full texts and the assigned profile.
rubric: Valuable philosophical contribution: overall quality, argument, significance and provisional originality. Explain actual inference and strongest objection. Clear expression helps reconstruction; no literary-style score. Distinguish unknown novelty from established duplication and an unverified objection from a demonstrated fatal error.
aggregation: Each valid review has equal influence in the preliminary common-rubric summary: 60% mean neutral and40% mean profile. This summary selects comparisons, not automatic winners. Missing reviews leave an explicit coverage gap; never count missing as zero or silently renormalize. Final decisions cite checked arguments from both blocks.
pair_selection: After all accepted individual results: prioritize E039/F02 overlap; then candidates near the eight/ten boundary, large neutral/profile disagreement, and high-potential minority cases. Freeze each exact pair, rationale, profiles and balanced A/B assignment before its5 fresh reviews. Maximum10 distinct pairs. A profile familiar with one text is not automatically reused for that text. No favorable-output reruns.
decision: Select8 strongest supported contributions then2 additional unusual/promising candidates with a defensible main argument. A verified central defect blocks admission; an allegation alone does not. No topic quota or rejection solely for overlapping subjects. Record checked original concerns in E078/E037/E074 and all other material limitations. Fewer than10 only if needed to avoid knowingly defective entries; explain any such shortfall.
source_checks: Initial reviews have no browsing and make source/novelty limits explicit. Coordinator checks decisive uncertain attributions or alleged defects against the precise text and primary sources; broad two-search literature audits belong to the later ten-to-three phase.
outputs: 22-row Russian decision report with exact current versions and2–3 concrete sentences per candidate
reading package with10 full unchanged essays in precommitted seeded order, no grades, selection rank or wildcard tags
preserved reviews, disagreements, targeted source checks, protected original hashes
project-memory update and existing private GitHub current-state update with the user role decision
archive: Freeze and archive method, inputs and current human authorization before dispatch. Verify native exact prompt, model/effort, no tools and one final; archive visible records and outputs before synthesis or pair selection. No hidden reasoning or whole-provider claim.
failure_policy: No automatic retries. Preserve every started attempt. Actual quota, unexpected input/tools/config or mandatory archival failure stops dispatch/dependent work. A format failure or observed internal sampling retry is quarantined as missing; any repair requires a separately recorded technical decision without choosing a favorable answer.
stop: After accepted reading package and authorized GitHub update. No final three, submission, public release, Claude, paid API or quota automation.
